headline: There are a lot of things in this world we can't fix
body: /But what if we stopped waiting for one big thing to change the world?/
What if we spent a little energy helping _families feel closer_, +little ones feel safer+, and /parents slow down/?

Every time you buy an original lullaby,
_we create one for a family in need._
So yeah. _Let's change the world a little._

*One family.
One baby.
One lullaby at a time.*
ask: Hit all the buttons. Let's get this in front of as many parents as possible.
